message.content:
An editorial magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white letters features a background and foreground composed entirely of various medicinal pills, capsules, and blister packs. These medications come in diverse colors including red, blue, green, yellow, pink, white, and black, in round, oval, and cylindrical shapes.

In the center, black capsules are arranged into a caricature of a face wearing thin black-rimmed glasses. Two red capsules form the nose, and two large pink capsules form the cheeks. A cluster of black capsules creates a beard-like shape below the nose.

On the left, large yellow text on black rectangles reads: "PIL PAHIT TERAWAN". Below this, smaller yellow-on-black text reads: "MENTERI KESEHATAN MENGUBAH SISTEM LELANG PENGADAAN OBAT DENGAN DALIH MEMBERANTAS MAFIA FARMASI. NASIB PULUHAN RIBU PASIEN JUSTRU TERANCAM."

Text at the top reads "SILANG-SENGKARUT DATA CORONA" and "ANCAMAN KRISIS PANGAN PAGEBLUK". In the lower left, "TERAWAN AGUS PUTRANTO" is printed. The bottom right displays a barcode, "9 770126 427302", a QR code, "20-26 APRIL 2020", "RP 45.000", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN".
